proposals.citation: dedr[entry 318];blairetal2012kurumba[Appendix C, printed p. 243, item 240, list SNSK, Pudukkottai Kurumba]
proposals.evidence: DEDR318 gives Kannada aṟa/aṟave/aṟive/aṟuve cloth and Tulu arve cloth/rag. Survey Kannada āraba/ārbā is proposed comparatively within this cloth family, with b corresponding to the comparator v and syncopation in ārbā; vowel length and consonant differences remain explicit rather than being normalized away. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.citation: dedr[entry 3296];blairetal2012kurumba[Appendix C, printed p. 280, item 72, list SNSK, Kolar Kurubas]
proposals.evidence: DEDR3296 gives Kannada tuṭi/toḍi, Tulu duḍi and Kota tuc lip. The survey dental/retroflex and voicing variants are preserved; Badaga/Sholaga and Alu Kurumba are comparative lect extensions, and Kota tus is compared with the specifically attested Kota tuc. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.citation: dedr[entry 561];blairetal2012kurumba[Appendix C, printed p. 281, item 89, list SNSK, Kolar Kurubas]
proposals.evidence: DEDR561 gives Kannada ugur, Tulu uguru, Kodagu oy and Kurukh orᵒx finger-nail. Survey uguru/ugarɨ and glide variants are comparative regional matches, with initial v-/a- and medial-y notation preserved. Kurukh orox matches the corrected rhotic spelling; the primary explicitly rejects Grignard’s oṛᵒx, so survey retroflex-r forms are held separately. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
